spans.s:
Vaḍava is a common name for a ‘mare’ in the later Saṃhitās and the Brāhmaṇas.
Foot notes taittirīya Saṃhitā, vii. 1, 1, 2; taittirīya brāhmaṇa, i. 8, 6, 3; iii. 8, 22, 3; Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, vi. 5, 2. 19, etc. A derivative of this word is the masculine vaḍava, taittirīya Saṃhitā, ii. 1, 8, 3.
